card.name: Punctuation and numbers in Revelation citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and numbers right after a citation of the Book of Revelation (Rev., Revelation), such as the period, colon, chapter or verse digits, and spaces in the reference.

modes.label: Separator after Rev
modes.description: The period, space or colon right after the book name Rev or Revelation and its chapter number.

modes.label: Verse numbers in the reference
modes.description: Chapter or verse digits and spaces inside a list of Revelation verses.

card.writes: It suppresses heaven and hell words, so it keeps the model from drifting into afterlife terms inside a scripture reference.
card.plain: It fires inside Bible references to the Book of Revelation, on the punctuation and numbers after the book name.
